punchline: Kelly built one very long corridor so specialists could not avoid each other.
thirty_sec: Mervin Kelly, who ran Bell Labs in the 1950s, favoured a Murray Hill building organised around a very long corridor, so physicists, chemists and engineers kept bumping into one another.
question: Which two people in your team would solve each other's problems if they happened to meet?
key_contrast: Do not schedule collaboration; build it into the route people walk.
